description: Proximity of Wildfires to Inpatient Healthcare Facilities in California, 2001-2023 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Neil Singh Bedi, Caleb J Dresser. The underlying dataset is associated with GitHub project https://github.com/nsbedi/wildfire-distances-inpt-hcfs . The data provides an annual distance to the nearest wildfire perimeter that occurred, for each licensed healthcare facility in California, for years 2001-2023. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
